name: player_reset_alt_gun_runtime_state

known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player alt-gun/runtime-state source-cluster pass.

The native smoke verifies trail deactivation, attach-state recycle and free-list relink, transition-state reset, door scale reset, and attach-node restore for the first and last looped banks.
